warningsAndPrecautions:
ZIOPTAN (tafluprost ophthalmic solution) 0.0015% is supplied as a sterile solution in translucent low density polyethylene single-dose containers packaged in foil pouches (10 single-dose containers per pouch). Each single-dose container has 0.3 mL solution corresponding to 0.0045 mg tafluprost.
                  
                  NDC 82584-609-30; Unit-of-Use Carton of 30.
